bullets: Turned raw webinar recordings into structured courses automatically: 8 hours down to under 15 minutes.

Built the finishing step: FFmpeg removes awkward Q&A pauses and the system produces 5 scenario-based quizzes per lesson.
Built the Featured Projects and All Projects pages in React and Tailwind CSS: 99 Lighthouse performance, 0.3 s first paint, zero layout shift.

projects.title: GoCDC
projects.overview: Most apps keep asking their database what changed. GoCDC listens to PostgreSQL's write-ahead log instead and streams every change to a Kafka-compatible broker (Redpanda) at 1,400 events a second. Changes fan out to Redis and MongoDB with under 150 ms of lag, and zero events were lost in a 500-concurrent-transaction benchmark.

projects.title: Archivist
projects.overview: Teams agree on architecture rules, then forget them in code review. Archivist is a GitHub Action that reads each pull request with a LangGraph agent and checks it against the team's Architecture Decision Records. In simulations it blocked injected violations like client-side secret leaks, and cut feedback from hours to under 60 seconds.

projects.title: Dayta
projects.overview: Academic schedules are long PDFs nobody wants to search. Dayta reads them, stores the meaning in Pinecone, and answers questions in a chat that remembers the conversation. Guardrails keep every answer inside official university data, preventing hallucinations.

projects.title: SkillUp
projects.overview: SkillUp reads a resume, compares it with a target role, and suggests the projects and courses that close the gaps. Built at Hack101 in a collaborative sprint and placed 2nd out of 30+ teams.
